overview:
**Low fire danger continues today, driven mainly by gusty 19 mph NE winds even as fuels stay seasonally damp.**
- Fire danger is forecast to stay Low all week, with ERC and BI percentiles easing from the high-40s/high-50s today down into the mid-30s by November 26.
- Today's wind reading of 19 mph is the only one of seven local watchout thresholds triggered; no other indicators are elevated.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted for this area; NWS instead calls for snow showers tonight into Saturday with gusts to 30–45 mph and lows near 21°F.
- Fire restrictions are currently lifted: the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests rescinded Stage 1 Fire Restrictions on September 3, and Gunnison County confirmed it remains not under fire restrictions as of September 18; check locally before any burning.
- No active wildfires are reported in or near Gunnison, Saguache, San Miguel, Hinsdale, Chaffee, Pitkin, Mesa, Delta, Ouray, Montrose, San Juan, Mineral, or Dolores counties today.
